Docusign Envelope ID: C92A1974-9DC1-4DFF-B82A-DCC2BB323D3C General Services Administration Public Buildings Service Acquisition Management Division Services Acquisition Branch (6P1QC) Contract 47PL0224D0002 Operations and Mechanical Maintenance Services Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building 1220 SW 3rd Avenue, Portland, OR Justification for Other than Full and Open Competition RFO FAR 6.103-2, GSA Agency Deviation RFO-2025-06, Unusual and Compelling Urgency Sole Source Bridge Contract to Maintain Continuity of Services Nature and/or description of the action being approved.

Contract 47PL0218D0011 was awarded to Northern Management Services by GSA PBS Region 10, with an effective date of July 1, 2018. This contract ended December 31, 2023 and, sole source contract 47PL0224D0002 was awarded to Northern Management Services. This sole source contract served as a bridge with a one-year period of performance, four one-month option periods, and a six month extension. The full period of performance for this contract was January 1, 2024 - October 31, 2025.

Late March, 2025, GSA PBS Region 6 took over the contracting functions from Region 10. Unsuccessful offer letters were sent by the new contracting team on March 21, 2025, and de-briefings were held March 31, 2025. TeamGOV, one of the unsuccessful quoters also filed a protest on March 31, 2025.

GSA PBS Region 6 prepared a response to this protest, but ultimately there was insufficient documentation to support the award decision and no remaining personnel to provide statements. In conjunction with the Office of General Council, Region 6 responded to the protest with corrective action and cancelled this award.

The anticipated consolidated contract is not in place and services will currently end altogether at the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building on October 31, 2025.

The purpose behind this bridge contract will allow us time to award a consolidated Facilities Engineering contract, which would combine the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt building with other Portland area buildings under a single Facilities Engineering contract.

This justification is for an emergency, sole source bridge contract to provide Operations and Mechanical Maintenance services at the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building, 1220 SW 3rd Avenue, Portland OR 97204 for a period of approximately 1-year, starting on November 1, Docusign Envelope ID: C92A1974-9DC1-4DFF-B82A-DCC2BB323D3C 2025, through October 31, 2026. This bridge contract will be a firm fixed-price, commercial item, performance-based contract, and will contain no additional option periods.

Description of the supplies or services required to meet the agency's needs (including the estimated value).

The General Services Administration (GSA) has determined there is a continued need for the provision of operation and mechanical maintenance services at the subject location, starting on November 1, 2025, through October 31, 2026.

The Contractor will continue to provide all administration, management, supervision, labor, materials, supplies, repair parts, tools and equipment; and must plan, schedule, coordinate, inspect and ensure effective and economical completion of all work and services specified for the operation, maintenance and repair of the building(s), equipment and related services, all equipment, electrical and mechanical systems, structures, architectural finishes, and utilities, located on, within, or beneath, this facility's interior and exterior extending to the legal property line at the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building.

Period of Performance for Bridge Contract: November 1, 2025 through October 31, 2026 Estimated Value of Bridge Contract: ███████████████████████████████████████████ Statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition.

RFO FAR 6.103-2, GSA Agency Deviation RFO-2025-06, Unusual and Compelling Urgency; 41 U.S.C. 3304(a)(2), Use of Noncompetitive Procedures Demonstration the nature of the acquisition requires use of the authority cited.

The Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building houses numerous government agencies and their employees, and a disruption in these services would directly impact their ability to perform their missions. Potential consequences include: building safety and occupant well-being, mission critical operations, damage to government property, and increased costs.

Due to the GAO protest and corrective action resulting in the termination of BPA 47PL0225A0001, there is not sufficient time to properly conduct a competitive full and open procurement to fulfill the Government’s requirements. The GAO protest created an immediate and significant challenge to the planned procurement process. Per FAR 16.191, a bridge contract may be appropriate when (1) the competitive follow-on contract or solicitation has been protested.

Northern Management Services is best situated to continue fulfilling these services. There would be significant phase-in and phase-out activities associated with the potential transition to another vendor In order to provide a successful transition, a new vendor would need at least 60 days to perform initial inspections, submit necessary documentation (e.g. building operation plan, deficiency report, etc.), and any other work required before the start of the period of Docusign Envelope ID: C92A1974-9DC1-4DFF-B82A-DCC2BB323D3C performance.

Additionally, the risk of bringing in a different contractor to perform these services on short notice and for only a one-year duration with no options would be significant in terms of increased pricing and potential performance failure at the site. The Government has less than 180 days until October 31, 2025, to award a bridge contract to ensure Operations and Mechanical Maintenance services continue at the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building. Based on the extremely short time available to make an award, a sole source procurement utilizing RFO FAR 6.103-2, GSA Agency Deviation RFO-2025-06, Unusual and Compelling Urgency is the Government's only viable option to ensure services are maintained.

Efforts made to ensure that offers are solicited from as many potential sources as is practicable, including whether a notice was or will be publicized as required by subpart 5.2 and, if not, which exception under 5.202 applies.

Due to the circumstances under which this bridge contract is required, it is impracticable for the Government to request offers from as many potential sources as possible (see above). Only the incumbent vendor has the ability to continue services without the need for additional site visits, interstate travel, and phase-in of new employees, equipment, and other items necessary to provide the requested services.

However, during this bridge contract period of performance the Government will work to submit a solicitation to the Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) under FAR Part 8.4. This solicitation will be for a negotiated, performance based, requirements contract that will be set-aside for total small businesses in accordance with FAR 6.203 and 19.502-2. The expected beginning of performance for the new solicited award will be November 1, 2026.

No synopsis is required for this contract action in accordance with the exception identified under FAR 5.202(a)(2). This bridge contract must be awarded in less than 60 days, which does not give the Government time to comply with the time periods specified in FAR 5.203. By synopsizing the requirement, the Government would be seriously injured as required services would not be offered at the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building for an extended duration.

However, in accordance with 41 U.S.C §3304 and RFO FAR 6.301(b)(1), GSA Agency Deviation RFO-2025-06 the justification for non-competitive procedures will be posted to the Government Point of Entry (GPE) within 30 days of award of the bridge contract.

Determination that the anticipated cost to the Government will be fair and reasonable.

The Contracting Officer has determined the anticipated cost of this bridge contract to be fair and reasonable. The determination is based on the following facts: (1) this bridge contract is being issued to a current O&M vendor in Region 10 who is familiar with the building and the scope of work and has a track record of good past performance and reasonable pricing; (2) the Docusign Envelope ID: C92A1974-9DC1-4DFF-B82A-DCC2BB323D3C Government developed an IGE which accounts for the unusual nature of this bridge contract; and (3) the labor rates for productive personnel are set by the Department of Labor Wage and Hour Division and are applicable to all Service Contract Labor Standards Act. These factors allow the Contracting Officer to determine the cost for this bridge contract to be fair and reasonable.

A description of the market research conducted.

No additional market research has been conducted for this bridge contract.

Any other facts supporting the use of other than full and open competition.

In this instance, failure to produce a bridge contract will result in Operations and Mechanical Maintenance services to stop at the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building. There will be significant failure in the operation of the building and in the support of the agency tenants if services are not continued. Conducting a full procurement with full and open competition would result in necessary services not being performed to maintain the building at a level required for tenant occupancy. This is in violation of our occupancy agreements with our tenant agencies and may result in preventable damage to the building that could be exceedingly expensive to repair or replace.

A listing of the sources, if any, that expressed, in writing, an interest in the acquisition.

N/A

Statement of the actions, if any, the agency may take to remove or overcome any barriers to competition before any subsequent acquisition for the supplies or services required.

The re-procurement of Operations and Mechanical Maintenance services for the Edith Green Wendell Wyatt Federal Building will be procured through eBuy, using full and open competition after exclusion of sources in accordance with FAR 6.203, set-asides for small business concerns. This re-procurement will be conducted during the period of performance of this bridge contract which will provide ample time for small business participation.
